children: said Tuesday it signed a ​liquefied natural gas supply agreement with South Korean steelmaker ‌POSCO
and a purchase agreement with Canada's Western LNG; financial terms were not disclosed.
said it agreed to key commercial terms with POSCO
for a 10-year supply of LNG sourced from Santos' diversified global LNG portfolio on a delivered ex-ship basis, with supply starting in 2030 or 2031.

The Australian company also entered into a heads of agreement with Western LNG to purchase ~1M metric tons/year of LNG from the proposed Ksi Lisims LNG project in British Columbia on a free on board basis for up to 20 years from around 2031.
Ksi Lisims is a proposed 12M tons/year floating LNG export project on land owned by the Nisga'a Nation.
